meta.title: Forsaken
meta.description: The sight of a receding back is a sign of deliberate distancing.

units.rawText: It is late at night, and the concert venue is deserted. The only people left here are 4You, reflecting on their disastrous stage show.
units.displayText: It is late at night, and the concert venue is deserted. The only people left here are 4You, reflecting on their disastrous stage show.

spans.text: It is late at night, and the concert venue is deserted. The only people left here are 4You, reflecting on their disastrous stage show.

units.rawText: Well, that went about as badly as it could have.
units.displayText: Well, that went about as badly as it could have.

spans.text: Well, that went about as badly as it could have.

units.rawText: Maybe a concert tour isn't a good idea... Not all places are like the Oasis and Burbank...

units.rawText: I guess these Battle-types never had the concept of entertainment written into their base layer logic.
units.displayText: I guess these Battle-types never had the concept of entertainment written into their base layer logic.

spans.text: I guess these Battle-types never had the concept of entertainment written into their base layer logic.

units.rawText: Frankly speaking... I doubt they even have the emotional capacity to even comprehend our show.

units.rawText: No, I'm sure some agents out there were touched by it. You should have seen them, there were a few curious and excited expressions in that blank-faced crowd back then.

units.rawText: My guess is that they were unsure about how to respond because Cyclopes has never had entertainment like this before.
units.displayText: My guess is that they were unsure about how to respond because Cyclopes has never had entertainment like this before.

units.rawText: That's true. We ought to look on the bright side—a negative reaction is better than none at all.
units.displayText: That's true. We ought to look on the bright side—a negative reaction is better than none at all.

spans.text: That's true. We ought to look on the bright side—a negative reaction is better than none at all.

units.rawText: Making them recognize and feel this "irregularity" will be the first breeze in our idol storm!
units.displayText: Making them recognize and feel this "irregularity" will be the first breeze in our idol storm!

units.rawText: If our music can move them... Then we ought to give it another try.
units.displayText: If our music can move them... Then we ought to give it another try.

spans.text: If our music can move them... Then we ought to give it another try.

units.rawText: Understood. I hope we aren't imagining things.
units.displayText: Understood. I hope we aren't imagining things.

spans.text: Understood. I hope we aren't imagining things.

units.rawText: Well, since everyone agrees... Let's have a comeback concert in five days' time. We must... we must wipe away our past shame.
units.displayText: Well, since everyone agrees... Let's have a comeback concert in five days' time. We must... we must wipe away our past shame.

spans.text: Well, since everyone agrees... Let's have a comeback concert in five days' time. We must... we must wipe away our past shame.

units.rawText: So soon? Only five days?
units.displayText: So soon? Only five days?

units.rawText: We have other sectors to visit besides Cyclopes, so we don't have the time to find the right approach through trial and error.

spans.text: We have other sectors to visit besides Cyclopes, so we don't have the time to find the right approach through trial and error.

units.rawText: ...You're right. The Oasis' concert is also coming up soon, so we don't have a moment to waste.

units.rawText: That would make me too obvious, so it doesn't seem too suitable. However, you're our group leader and the center of our performance.
